sloka: वेगितानां समर्थानामन्योन्यवधकाङ्क्षिणाम् ।परस्परं चाह्वयतां निनादः श्रूयते महान् ।। ६.५७.४५ ।।।।
transliteration: vegitānāṁ samarthānāmanyonyavadhakāṅkṣiṇām ।parasparaṁ cāhvayatāṁ ninādaḥ śrūyate mahān ।। 6.57.45 ।।।।

translations.english: The yelling noise of Rakshasas and roaring noise of Vanaras of both armies, who were powerful and seized with speed, who sought the destruction of one another, challenging noises of Rakshasas and Vanaras, highly rejoiced, was heard.
